snippet.title: PAKO Highway DEMO trailer
snippet.description:
PAKO Highway is love letter to early 2000s arcade racing games!

Drive through endless highways, do near-misses with traffic to gain BOOST, when boost meter is filled, CRASH to traffic to gain more time to clock! 

We are still in the demo phase and adding features, cars, maps and so but you can have a spin at:

Apple Store:
https://apps.apple.com/app/pako-highway/id1640030728
Testflight beta available:
https://testflight.apple.com/join/Th81jYv4

Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.treemengames.pakohighway

Itch.io:
https://treemengames.itch.io/pako-highway-early-demo

Feedback welcome!
